attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS test_file_path FROM code.files f JOIN code.imports i ON i.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_test AND (i.module_name = 'click.testing' OR i.module_name LIKE 'click.testing.%')

request:
Which test files contain an import statement that imports the click.testing module or any name from it? A test that only reaches click.testing through an attribute of the click package without importing it does not count. tests/conftest.py counts as a test file. Give the repository-relative path of each test file.

Requested output columns: test_file_path (string).
explanation: This query joins test files to their import rows and keeps those whose imported module name is click.testing or a submodule of it (e.g. click.testing.CliRunner imports resolving to click.testing). It returns each distinct test file path that directly imports that module.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS test_file_path FROM code.files f JOIN code.imports i ON i.file_id = f.file_id WHERE f.is_test AND (i.module_name = 'click.testing' OR i.module_name LIKE 'click.testing.%')
